## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 18-fascicle text by [宗密](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E5%AF%86) Zōngmì is the great Buddhist liturgical-ritual manual for the *Yuánjué jīng* 圓覺經 (*[Sūtra of Perfect Awakening](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0551)*, T0842) — the Mahāyāna scripture that, alongside the *Avataṃsaka*, was central to Zōngmì's Chán-Huáyán synthesis. The 18-fascicle scope makes the work one of the most extensive Buddhist ritual manuals of the Tang period, and the principal liturgical-ritual manual of the *Yuánjué jīng* tradition.

**Abstract**

The work is conventionally datable to [宗密](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E5%AF%86) Zōngmì's mature period at the Cǎotángsì on Mt. Guīfēng, c. 820 – 841 CE. The bracket adopted here reflects this window. The 18-fascicle scope reflects the elaborate liturgical-cosmological architecture of the ritual, which Zōngmì developed alongside his major doctrinal work on the *Yuánjué jīng* (the *[Yuánjué jīng dà shū 圓覺經大疏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0555)*).

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1475) collection.
